method: Catalog-wide first-frame visual screening: all 297 Faux SOGs and all 96 Faux Bitcorn memberships. Reviewed all 292 SoG reference previews; Subsequently reviewed all 366 Bitcorn Crops reference previews; enlarged selected Bitcorn and Rare Pepe follow-ups. First-frame screening does not exclude reuse in later frames. Generic template or subject is not specific-source evidence. Enlarged side-by-side comparisons for accepted matches. Screened-no-specific-match means no lead identified in this pass, not an exhaustive rejection.
